scope: Unauthenticated public specification only; no OCD account permission or behaviour is established by this snapshot.
material_contract_findings: Shift updates accept description and km, with invoiced/cancelled state restrictions.
Recurrence operations are documented, but are not implemented by the current occurrence-only adapter.
Recurring availability is a pattern, not proof of availability or willingness on a given day.
Invoiceable-item account sweeps use cursor pagination.
Staff onboarding_status records a status; it does not itself grant or revoke sign-in access.
